tool_args.rationale: Fit the documented coarse adiabatic relaxation law numerically to all five paid rows. Store fitted parameters for predict(row); avoid further paid measurements because the horizon is near the observed range and the simpler family is identifiable.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The documented coarse adiabatic family is directly testable with the five varied initial-state observations; the existing rows suffice to fit its two parameters.
It is a nested limiting possibility, but the varied x_now values provide information about relaxation; fitting the relaxation rate lets the data determine whether it is effectively static.
The archive requires at least eight rows for that four-parameter family, and current evidence plus fast-transient-damped signature favors the simpler coarse model.
